title: MNA_MLOps
summary: An MLOps project (Equipo 43) building a time-series pipeline to predict power consumption in Tetouan City, Morocco, using the UCI Power Consumption dataset with DVC-based reproducibility tooling. The project's requirements.txt pins sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas, but no code in the repository actually imports or calls them.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.26.0, ctgan==0.11.0, rdt==1.18.1, sdmetrics==0.23.0, copulas==0.12.3; no matching code usage found
needs: SDV-family packages are pinned in requirements.txt but no source file shows an import or call; usage cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
